content: # User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative.
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.
## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.
## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.
Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I'm Alex Thompson, a manager at Success LLC. I've really enjoyed using your CRM and I'm actually looking to refer a few of my colleagues to your service. Before I make those introductions, I'd love to understand a bit more about your referral program. Could you help me set up a referral opportunity named 'Success LLC Referral'? I know my account already exists in your system, so I just need to get that referral link or process started.

content: I've confirmed your account — Alex Thompson, Founder at Success LLC (Consulting). Everything is linked correctly.

Before I create the referral opportunity, I want to be transparent about one thing: I don't have information about a formal referral program (like a referral link or specific rewards structure) in the system I can access. I can absolutely create the referral opportunity record to track your introductions, but I want to make sure I don't promise any specific referral benefits I can't verify.
Here's what I can do right now:
- **Create the "Success LLC Referral" opportunity** linked to your account so we can track the colleagues you're introducing.

Would you like me to go ahead and create that opportunity record? And if you have specific questions about referral rewards or a referral link, I can flag those for a team member who handles program details — just let me know.
That sounds perfect. Yes, please go ahead and create the "Success LLC Referral" opportunity record linked to my account. That's exactly what I need to track the introductions I'm planning to make.

I'm not looking for a specific referral link or rewards structure right now; I just want to ensure there's a formal way to log these potential leads so we can follow up later. Once that's set up, I'll be happy to start sharing your service with my team.

Done! Your **"Success LLC Referral"** opportunity has been created and linked to your account (Alex Thompson / Success LLC). It's currently in the **NEW** stage, ready to track the colleagues you'll be introducing.
A couple of quick notes:

- As you share your introductions, just send me the names (and companies, if you have them) of the colleagues you're referring, and I can log each one as a lead and connect them to this referral opportunity for follow-up.
- Since you mentioned you're not focused on rewards or a referral link right now, I've left those aside — but if that changes, just let me know and I can flag it for the right team member.
Whenever you're ready to start sharing your team's details, I'm here to help log them. Thanks for the referrals, Alex!
That works perfectly for me. I'll start reaching out to my team soon and will send you the names and company details as I go so you can log them properly.
Thanks for setting this up, Alex. I appreciate your help in getting the tracking in place. I'll be in touch shortly with the first few names.

You're very welcome, Alex! The "Success LLC Referral" opportunity is all set and ready to go. Whenever you have the first names and company details, just send them my way and I'll log each one as a lead and connect them to the referral opportunity for follow-up.
Thanks again for the referrals — I look forward to hearing from you soon. Have a great day!
